oracle.domain: Every finite FP16 encoding with value in [-10,10].
oracle.method: Direct mathematical MPFR expm1 with RoundDown and RoundUp, then outward conversion of each endpoint to binary64. Independent mpmath expm1 must lie inside every MPFR interval.
oracle.independence: The oracle uses no candidate exponent reduction, split log(2), polynomial coefficients, or FP32 reconstruction.
oracle.scope: Exhaustive scalar-domain oracle. Tensor indexing and GPU execution are checked separately.

indexing.argument: For index=program_id*BLOCK+lane, adjacent blocks cover disjoint adjacent intervals. mask index<N retains [0,N) exactly once. The full legal N range has 1..BLOCK active lanes in its last block, with int32-safe address indices.
indexing.scope: Arithmetic model of the audited source indexing, not exhaustive GPU testing of every N, address, or compiler specialization.

cpu_audit.scope: Full legal-FP16 scalar reference audit; GPU arithmetic is checked separately.
